SEAMUN I 2027 — no pages: This conference does not recruit committee pages. Delegates pass notes digitally through InterMUN; there is no paper note-passing or page staff.

Chairs are expected to be diplomatic, professional, impartial, engaging, calm, creative, empathetic, passionate, decisive, welcoming, punctual, encouraging, and accountable — with additional expectations for ESL and crisis committees (realistic crises, no celebrities).

Chair report: High-quality study guide required. Download the official chair report template (PDF).

Chair decisions (SEAMUN I 2027 only): The chair decisions mechanism applies only to this conference—not other MUNs on SEAMUNs. Download PDF · Open in new tab · View on Chair Guide

Applications: Chair application form (also in the Forms section).

extraNotes:
SEAMUN I 2027 — Policies with a Purpose. Student-led, non-profit Model UN conference at D-PREP International School Secondary Campus (Bang Phli, Samut Prakan). Official site: seamun.com.

Mission: Integrate the MUN circuit in a prestigious and inclusive manner. As a non-profit initiative, SEAMUN promotes professionalism, creativity, and collaboration through a sustainable, high-tech, and unbiased conference. All surplus is donated to TRCS (Thai Red Cross Society).

Grades: Open to ages 12–18 (Grades 7–12 / Years 8–13), with committee-specific grade ranges.

Fees: Delegate 2,500 THB · Chair 800 THB · Advisors & media/photographers: free.

Advisors: Schools or institutions sending two or more delegates and/or chairs must register an advisor. For school delegations, all delegates and chairs must complete the delegate or chair sign-up form respectively; advisors must complete the advisor sign-up form.

Registration: All delegates use the delegate sign-up form (school and independent options are explained in the form). Chairs and advisors use their respective forms.

Capacity: 200 delegates, 20 chairs, up to 60 staff (including student staff).

Academic: 10 committees. Crisis committees: UNSC and FWC (Fantasy World). Position papers are required for awards eligibility. Digital note passing via the conference platform.

Contact: information@seamun.com · @seamun.th.conference

Resources: Rules of Procedure (RoP) · Chair Guide · All registration forms · Delegate sign up · Advisor sign up · Chair application.
